You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based solely on the chest X-ray findings in Figures 2 and 3, which of the following is the most likely diagnosis for the patient's condition, considering the presence and extent of interstitial air and subcutaneous emphysema?

A) Pneumothorax
B) Spontaneous pneumomediastinum
C) Secondary pneumomediastinum due to trauma
D) Respiratory infection with subcutaneous emphysema
E) Asthma exacerbation with associated subcutaneous emphysema
F) Mallory-Weiss syndrome
